title: Proviyaa Restaurant Vendor Panel
subtitle: How a restaurant runs on it, step by step
text: This is the Proviyaa restaurant vendor panel. One login for the whole restaurant, working online and offline, on the same database as Proviyaa master.

title: Onboard the restaurant in Proviyaa master
text: Your team onboards a restaurant in Proviyaa master: add the partner, its branches, and the owner's login. The same database and the same login work in the vendor panel.

title: The owner signs in
text: The owner signs in to the vendor panel, sets their own password on the first sign-in, and lands on the restaurant dashboard: sales, orders, pending verifications, kitchen and staff at a glance.

title: Build the menu
text: In Master, the restaurant builds its menu: sections, dishes with photos, veg or non-veg, prices, kitchen stations, and the channels each dish is sold on.

title: Stock, recipes and suppliers
text: Raw materials, recipes with food cost, supplier price quotes and purchase orders keep the kitchen's costs under control.

title: Floor plan and tables
text: Operations starts with the floor plan: floors and tables, reservations, seating guests, and taking the order right at the table.

title: Kitchen tickets
text: Every order raises a kitchen ticket. The kitchen screen moves it from new, to preparing, to ready.

title: Billing and payments
text: POS Billing handles dine-in, takeaway and delivery bills. Cash settles at once. Card and UPI stay pending until a manager verifies them.

title: Live orders, delivery and online
text: Live Operations shows every order in real time, with delivery riders and Swiggy or Zomato orders in the same place.

title: Works offline
text: If the internet drops, billing continues on the device. Changes queue up, and sync to the server the moment the connection returns.

title: Chain view for several branches
text: Owners of more than one outlet get the chain view: branch performance, stock across branches, transfers, targets, exceptions and compliance.

title: Staff and roles
text: Staff and Users holds employees, attendance, shifts, salaries and app logins. Six roles: owner, restaurant admin, branch manager, cashier, captain and kitchen. Each sees only its own screens.

title: Each role gets its own panel
text: A branch manager sees only their branch. Cashiers get the POS, captains the tables, and the kitchen just its display.

title: Customers, finance, tasks and more
text: Customers and loyalty, marketing campaigns, finance, the task manager, integrations and settings complete the back office.

title: One database. One login.
subtitle: Proviyaa master and the vendor panel, together
text: All of it runs on one database with Proviyaa master, so what the platform sets up is exactly what the restaurant sees. That is the Proviyaa restaurant vendor panel.
